keyword: electric mixer pump same frame as electric 40

title.en: The Electric Mixer Shares a Frame Size with Electric 40 and Not the Weight
title.zh: 电动搅拌泵与电动40外形数字相同，重量不同

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm on both the electric mixer and Electric 40. Weights are 4500 kg and 2300 kg. The mixer also prints a 14 kW mixer motor.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm 同时印在电动搅拌泵和电动40上。重量是 4500 kg 和 2300 kg。搅拌泵还印搅拌电机 14 kW。

h1.en: Do Not Order the Mixer from Electric 40’s Weight
h1.zh: 不要按电动40的重量去订搅拌泵

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the integrated mixer at main motor 45 kW plus mixer motor 14 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, 100 m / 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm and 4500 kg. Electric 40 prints 45 kW only, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, two stone rows, no pipe diameter on the list used here, the same frame numbers and 2300 kg. A transport note that uses 2300 kg for the mixer is the wrong machine. Send [/en/products/integrated-mixer-pump/](/en/products/integrated-mixer-pump/) when both motors are required. No price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）把搅拌泵一体机印成主电机 45 kW 加搅拌电机 14 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、100 m / 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm、4500 kg。电动40只印 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、两行石子，此处使用的列表没有管径，外形数字相同，重量 2300 kg。运输说明如果给搅拌泵写 2300 kg，机器就错了。两台电机都需要时，发送 [/zh/products/integrated-mixer-pump/](/zh/products/integrated-mixer-pump/)。没有印价格。

heading.en: Pipe is the mixer’s extra cell
heading.zh: 管径是搅拌泵多出来的格子

body.en: 100 / 125 mm is printed on the mixer. It is not printed on the Electric 40 list used here.
body.zh: 100 / 125 mm 印在搅拌泵上。此处使用的电动40列表没有。

body.en: The mixer prints 100 m / 300 m only. Electric 40 prints fine-stone and aggregate-13 rows. Do not paste those rows onto the mixer.
body.zh: 搅拌泵只印 100 m / 300 m。电动40印细石和 13 骨料两行。不要把那两行贴到搅拌泵上。

body.en: Write both kilowatt numbers and 4500 kg to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/).
body.zh: 把两个千瓦数字和 4500 kg 写到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。

question.en: Is 21 m³/h enough to prove they are one machine?
question.zh: 21 m³/h 能否证明是同一台机器？

answer.en: No. Both pages print 21 m³/h and then different motor counts and weights.
answer.zh: 不能。两页都印 21 m³/h，然后电机数量和重量不同。

question.en: Is the mixer a mixing plant?

answer.en: 4 cm and below on the mixer.
answer.zh: 搅拌泵是 4 cm 及以下。

alt.en: Integrated mixer pump manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery, a Xingtai concrete pump manufacturer
alt.zh: 搅拌泵一体机，由河北品锦机械厂家制造，邢台
